name: Funaoka Rie
source:
Naoko's junior who comes to visit her on her days off, and for some reason decides to play strip mahjong with her. She is the one who got the main character, her brother-in-law, involved.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmmj.html]official site[/url]]
